id_source: NOT in the CREATE FEMBY instance. Ids verified against a reference 1.20.1 Forge jar taken from another instance on this machine - correct for the mod, but they will not resolve in this pack until the mod is added.
no_video_evidence: transcription did not complete for this mod; human_notes below are jar-derived only

order: [jar] There is no item ladder to order. dungeons_arise registers ZERO items and ZERO blocks - 39 structures and 171 chest loot tables, nothing else. Any quest for this mod is 'go to this place', never 'craft this thing'.
gates: [jar] The only real gate is gear tier, and it is legible from the loot: the iron/chainmail structures are safe at early-game kit, the netherite/totem structures are not.
structures: [jar] TOP TIER, netherite and totems in the chests, treat as end-game destinations: dungeons_arise:shiraz_palace (netherite_scrap x4, netherite_boots, 6x diamond armour pieces - the richest in the mod), dungeons_arise:heavenly_challenger, dungeons_arise:heavenly_conqueror, dungeons_arise:heavenly_rider (all three carry totem_of_undying, enchanted_golden_apple and netherite_scrap), dungeons_arise:aviary (netherite_ingot, enchanted_golden_apple, full diamond kit), dungeons_arise:keep_kayra (diamond armour x4-5 plus 7 enchanted books).

[jar] STRONG MID TIER, diamond and enchanted books: dungeons_arise:foundry (netherite_scrap, diamond_block, emerald_block, blaze rods - a Nether-flavoured forge), dungeons_arise:scorched_mines, dungeons_arise:infested_temple, dungeons_arise:illager_fort, dungeons_arise:thornborn_towers, dungeons_arise:bandit_towers, dungeons_arise:plague_asylum.

[jar] UTILITY, worth a detour for one specific thing rather than for the loot: dungeons_arise:mining_system and dungeons_arise:mushroom_mines (diamond_pickaxe in the treasure tables), dungeons_arise:fishing_hut (a trident, in a tiny building), dungeons_arise:mechanical_nest (redstone gear - lightning_rod, redstone_block, redstone_lamp), dungeons_arise:small_blimp (pistons, comparators, repeaters).

[jar] LOW TIER, flavour builds: dungeons_arise:small_prairie_house, dungeons_arise:merchant_campsite, dungeons_arise:mushroom_village, dungeons_arise:greenwood_pub, dungeons_arise:bathhouse, dungeons_arise:lighthouse, dungeons_arise:fishing_hut, dungeons_arise:wishing_well, dungeons_arise:giant_mushroom.
[jar] Structures with no chest loot table at all, so purely scenery: dungeons_arise:coliseum, dungeons_arise:monastery is thin, dungeons_arise:wishing_well.
traps: [jar] dungeons_arise:typhon is the clearest trap in the mod: it is one of the largest and most imposing builds, and its entire chest table is one each of iron kit, a skeleton_skull and a single diamond. Huge time cost, near-zero reward.

[jar] dungeons_arise:illager_corsair and dungeons_arise:illager_galley share an identical, poor loot table (cobweb, tnt, one iron sword) despite being big ships crawling with illagers - the worst effort-to-reward pair after typhon.
[jar] dungeons_arise:bathhouse and dungeons_arise:greenwood_pub are almost entirely potions and food. Fine to visit, not worth a quest reward.

NOT VERIFIED BY VIDEO: the danger ranking here is inferred from loot tier and structure size, because the tier-list video did not finish transcribing. Treat the loot facts as solid and the 'how dangerous' half as an inference.
